project_name.justification: The article announces the acquisition of the KA property: "...the acquisition of the KA nickel-copper-cobalt-chrome-platinum group element property (the "Property")..."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as: "SKY GOLD CORP. ("Sky" or the "Company") (SKYG-TSX:V)(OTC PINK:SRKZF) is pleased to announce the acquisition..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO is listed at the end of the press release: "MIKE ENGLAND, CEO, PRESIDENT & DIRECTOR"

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement terms state the company will acquire a full interest: "To acquire a 100% interest in the Property..."

primary_commodity.justification: The property is described with Nickel as the leading commodity: "...the acquisition of the KA nickel-copper-cobalt-chrome-platinum group element property (the "Property")..."

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled "Sky Gold Consolidates Land Position in The Shebandowan Greenstone Belt, With the Acquisition of The KA Ni-Cu-Co-Cr-PGE Property, Northwestern Ontario", which directly relates to the project of interest.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Sky Gold Corp., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV:SKYG), which implies that the currency for payments denoted with a '$' symbol is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The completion announcement specifies the cash component of the deal: "the Company will issue up to 815,000 shares of Sky Gold and pay up to $150,000 in cash to the vendors, over a 4-year period."

share_payments_raw.justification: Per the extraction hierarchy, `amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price` are populated instead as the number of shares and a price are available.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Per the extraction hierarchy, separate cash and share components are available and have been extracted.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The agreement terms state the number of shares to be issued: "To acquire a 100% interest in the Property, the Company will issue 815,000 shares of Sky Gold..."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.02'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters was mentioned in the agreement terms.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No monetary exploration commitment was mentioned in the agreement terms.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction, a royalty was granted to the sellers: "The Company will additionally grant a 2.0% Royalty to the vendors."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text specifies the area of the KA property being acquired: "the Property comprises 37 unpatented claims totaling 655 hectares".

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified in the text: "the Property comprises 37 unpatented claims totaling 655 hectares".

resource_size.justification: The text mentions a resource for the neighboring Shebandowan mine ('8.7 million tonnes at 2.0% nickel...'), but not for the KA property itself. No resource has been defined for the KA property.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The company's ticker and exchange are provided in the text: "SKY GOLD CORP. ("Sky" or the "Company") (TSXV:SKYG)..." and confirmed in the detailed quote section: "Exchange: TSXV".
